meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你构建或修改界面后,自动对网页和终端界面做视觉检查:先截取屏幕或终端画面并与参考图对比,再用两个独立审查代理分别检查设计系统完整性和视觉细节(含中文/日文/韩文文字截断),最后给出“好/坏”结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或改动任何界面后,或问某个页面/组件/终端界面是否正常时触发;也适用于提到“视觉检查”“界面不对劲”“设计系统核对”等关键词时。

say.text: 我刚改了登录页样式,帮我做个视觉检查。
say.note: 会截图并与改动前对比,再派两个审查代理检查。

say.text: 这个终端界面边框对不齐了,看看哪里漂移。
say.note: 对标终端对齐与边框漂移问题。

say.text: 检查这个页面在中日韩文字下有没有被截断。
say.note: 专门检查中日韩文字截断与换行。

howto.what_en: After any UI build/change, Claude verifies web and terminal UIs: captures screenshots/TUI frames, diffs them against the reference, dispatches two read-only review passes (design-system and visual/CJK), then gives a good/bad verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after building or changing any UI, or when asked whether a page/component/TUI looks right. Also on keywords such as "visual QA", "UI looks wrong", "design system check", etc.

say_en.text: I just changed the login page style. Run a visual QA.
say_en.note: Will capture and run both review passes.

say_en.text: The TUI borders are misaligned. Find the drift.
Check this page for CJK text clipping.
